abstract: A case of a 35-year-old woman with mature teratoma which was perforated into the pericardial cavity, was reported. She was admitted to our hospital for surgical treatment of anterior mediastinal tumor. On her 6th hospital day, she had high fever. A chest X-ray and UCG showed cardiomegaly and pericardial effusion. We diagnosed her as perforated teratoma into the pericardial cavity and the emergent operation was performed. The tumor adheeded to pericardium and a large quality of bloody effusion was found in the pericardial cavity. The tumor was removed with pericardium immediately. In this case, the mechanism of perforation was thought to be caused by infection and massive fluid influx into the cyst.
abstract_ja: 35歳の女性で、心膜腔へ穿孔した成熟奇形腫の症例を報告する。前縦隔腫瘍の外科的治療目的で入院した。入院6日目に高熱が出現した。胸部X線写真および心エコー図（UCG）で心拡大と心嚢液貯留を認めた。心膜腔への奇形腫穿孔と診断し、緊急手術を施行した。腫瘍は心膜に癒着しており、心膜腔内には大量の血性心嚢液が認められた。腫瘍は心膜と一塊として直ちに切除された。本症例において、穿孔の機序は感染および嚢胞内への大量の液体流入によるものと考えられた。
